picks.why: WDC trades at 8.7x forward earnings with +56% revenue growth and a 48% operating margin, 57% below its 52-week high, so much of the cycle risk is already priced in. It ties to the memory thesis and to storage demand from the AI build-out, with Seagate's results tomorrow as a read-across.
picks.risk: A 2% FCF yield means the cheap multiple depends on peak-cycle earnings holding; a storage downturn would make it a value trap.

picks.why: Jabil has a 5% FCF yield, 12.4x forward earnings and +29% revenue growth, the best cash-flow cover on the shortlist, and the servers segment is covered only by HPE. It is a contract manufacturer of AI hardware, so it benefits from demand without carrying the neocloud debt.
picks.risk: A 6% operating margin leaves little room if hyperscaler capex is cut after this week's earnings.
